propositions: b690 enables req.config to influence Pass-1 execution, but plan-review.yaml declares model_ladder[0]=trivial, causing Pass-1 to downgrade from opus to haiku despite _verifier_cfg's docstring asserting the finder runs unaffected

Pass-1 finder silently downgraded from sonnet (effective PRE-b690) to haiku (effective POST-b690) because ProductionBatchRunner resolves cfg.model via model_ladder[0], and PydanticAIRunner.run previously discarded req.config but b690 now honors it

Sidecar archaeology shows 115 opus-attributed plan-review runs before 2026-06-27, zero after—a total changeover one day after _verifier_cfg landed, proving Pass-1 downgrade is an unnoticed regression not a design choice

Pass-1's context-limit escalation ladder is size-only, so plans fitting haiku's 200k window remain on haiku; prerequisite finder bin packing now occurs against haiku instead of sonnet/opus, changing when escalation fires

The fix requires plan-review.yaml model_ladder[0] rung changed from trivial to frontier so Pass-1 finder generates findings on opus as recorded before the regression, while Pass-2 verify and Pass-4 coach remain on standard/sonnet per _verifier_cfg intent
